children: iPower completed an Additional Optional Closing under its existing Securities Purchase Agreement, issuing $3,000,000 in Series A senior secured convertible notes to an institutional investor. The company received approximately $2,820,000 in gross proceeds (priced at $940 per $1,000 principal), before fees, with a fixed conversion price of $3.156. This draw is part of an up to $30 million facility, bringing total Series A issuance to $15.184 million to date, with $15 million remaining available.
